messages:
monitor-bot: ALERT: prod/payment-worker error rate spike — 5xx > 6% over 2m. Auto-runbooks triggered. incident-bot attempted paging but got suppression response.

lexi (oncall): I didn't get a page. only saw the channel alert.

miguel (sre): same. no pager entry. checking incident-bot logs.

sam (eng): I'm seeing a ton of 413 from attachment-service in the logs around the time of the alert.

miguel (sre): log snippet:
```
ERROR incidentbot/pager - suppress_page: payload_size=132479 bytes > max_payload=65536
resp: {"error":"attachment too large, suppressed"}
```

miguel (sre): incident-bot suppressed outbound page because the alert payload included a large stacktrace/attachment. That suppression path should still create an emergency page to oncall but it didn't.

lexi (oncall): manually paged @pager-team via PagerDuty. customer-facing impact: a small number of checkout failures. I'm starting a targeted restart of payment-worker canary.

sam (eng): rolling restart canary now.

pagerbot: NOTE: outbound webhook to pager-proxy returned 502 for suppressed pages at 3249876506, retry backoff engaged.

miguel (sre): root cause hypothesis: incident-bot 2.3.1 added strict suppression for attachment>64kb, but a regression prevented fallback minimal payload path from being sent.

jordan (sre-lead): escalate to incident-bot owner @sam and create a short incident ticket. we need an immediate mitigation and a postmortem.

sam (eng): created ticket: INC-4321. temporary mitigation: patch incident-bot to trim attachments and send minimal payload for paging; hotfix branch pushed, rolling deploy to incident-bot fleet in progress.

lexi (oncall): pager notifications are live now — I got the test page. :thumbsup:

miguel (sre): mitigation complete. canary payment-worker restart reduced 5xx to 0.8% in 10m.

lexi (oncall): customer impact: about ~120 failed checkouts over 15m window, automated retry fixed ~70, we emailed ~50 customers. product notified.

jordan (sre-lead): good. next steps: postmortem with timeline, change incident-bot suppression rule to log and fallback instead of fully suppressing, add unit test for trimmed-payload path, and ensure PagerRelay metrics emit suppressed_count.

sam (eng): agree. I'll open PR with tests and request review.

miguel (sre): added short note to ops runbook about manual paging path if suppressor triggers.

lexi (oncall): closing this thread once postmortem link is posted. thanks all.
